title: DeriveBSD UI Collection Handoff Receipt (v0.1)

subject.description: Exact receiving subject holding this richer-lane receipt after retrieve/materialization.

offer_source_subject.description: Exact source subject that created or exposed the reviewed finite collection.

grant_digest.description: Exact digest of the ui.collection.handoff.grant artifact consumed for this retrieve.

collection_digest.description: Authoritative compact identity of the reviewed collection joined for this retrieve.

handle.description: Receiver-local authoritative result-root handle. Must stay opaque and non-path-shaped on the portable contract surface.

display_path.description: Optional human-facing advisory display snapshot for the created fresh root. Retrieve-frozen when present.

display_label.description: Optional human-facing advisory destination label snapshot. Retrieve-frozen when present.

result_root.description: Exact created fresh result root. Handle is authoritative; display fields are advisory only.

grant_exhausted.description: True for the first-cut single-retrieve-autostop lane: the first successful retrieve exhausted the grant.

retrieved_at.description: ISO8601 time. Successful retrieve must not be later than the joined grant effective_until.

description: Portable retrieve/materialization receipt for the reviewed finite-collection handoff lane.
